summary: This stylesheet styles a Bluesky social media embed component with various sections for displaying posts, comments, user avatars, and engagement metrics. It uses CSS variables for theming to support both light and dark modes, and includes hover effects for interactive elements like buttons and links.

explanations.7: margin: 2rem 0 0.5rem means 2rem space above, no space on sides, and 0.5rem below — it separates this container from other content vertically.
explanations.45: display: flex turns this into a flexbox layout, which makes it easy to arrange child items in a row.
explanations.58: border-radius: 50% makes a square element into a circle by rounding all corners equally.
explanations.76: margin-left: auto pushes this element to the right side by consuming all available space on the left.
explanations.86: content: '❤️\a0' adds a heart emoji followed by a non-breaking space before the text using the ::before pseudo-element.
explanations.102: content: '→\a0' adds a right arrow followed by a non-breaking space before the link text.
explanations.124: flex-wrap: wrap allows items to break into multiple rows if they don't fit on one line.
explanations.155: [data-theme="dark"] .blueskyNoCommentYetCTA targets the button only when the page is in dark mode and changes its color accordingly.
explanations.172: margin-left: -1rem creates a negative margin that overlaps this element 1rem to the left, useful for stacking avatars on top of each other.
explanations.184: border: 2px solid var(--ifm-color-background-color) adds a colored border around the avatar to help it stand out against background images.
explanations.215: transition: ... enables smooth 0.2-second animations when background-color and color properties change, like on hover.
